Senior Full-Stack Developer at AdVerve Technologies, where I architect and scale adtech solutions that drive measurable business impact. With a track record of delivering high-performance, scalable systems that outperform industry benchmarks, I thrive at the intersection of innovation and execution. My expertise lies in building robust, real-time platforms that optimize ad delivery and user engagement—proving that simplicity and speed are non-negotiable in today’s fast-paced market.  

Adept at translating complex business requirements into elegant technical solutions, I leverage my background in full-stack development to bridge gaps between strategy and implementation. My toolkit includes crafting RESTful APIs, designing scalable database architectures, and deploying reactive applications that handle millions of requests with precision.  

Key strengths: Go for high-performance systems, PostgreSQL for reliable data management, React for intuitive UIs, and TypeScript for maintainable code. Always seeking challenges that push the boundaries of what’s possible in adtech—because the future belongs to those who build it. Let’s connect and drive innovation together.
